name: 戴榮冠
objective:
本課程以「台北建國啤酒廠故事與臺北科技大學」為核心議題，結合報導文學、田野調查與 GIS 故事地圖製作，引導學生觀察城市空間變遷與地方文化延續。
一、田野調查與人物專訪
學生將走入建國啤酒廠、臺北科技大學及周邊社區，訪問居民、店家、校友或文化工作者，蒐集地方記憶與生命故事。
二、報導文學寫作訓練
課程訓練學生將訪談資料轉化為具有人物描寫、場景敘事與社會觀察的報導文學作品，作為期中報告成果。
三、GIS 故事地圖建置
學生將整理訪談內容、歷史資料、照片與地點座標，運用 GIS 工具建置人物採訪故事地圖，呈現都市改建、產業記憶與文化保存之間的關係，作為期末成果。
四、課程目標
培養學生的文本書寫、田野觀察、數位敘事與地方關懷能力。

This course centers on the stories of the Taipei Jianguo Brewery and National Taipei University of Technology, and the continuity of surrounding local culture. It integrates reportage literature, fieldwork, and GIS-based story map production to guide students in observing urban spatial transformation and local cultural memory.
1. **Fieldwork and Personal Interviews**
   Students will visit the Jianguo Brewery, National Taipei University of Technology, and nearby communities to interview residents, shop owners, alumni, and cultural workers, collecting local memories and personal stories.
2. **Reportage Writing Training**
   Students will learn how to transform interview materials into reportage pieces that include character portrayal, scene narration, and social observation. This will serve as the midterm project.
3. **GIS Story Map Construction**
   Students will organize interview content, historical materials, photographs, and geographic coordinates, then use GIS tools to create a story map based on personal interviews. This will present the relationships among urban redevelopment, industrial memory, and cultural preservation, and will serve as the final project.
4. **Course Objectives**
   The course aims to cultivate students’ abilities in writing, field observation, digital storytelling, and local engagement.
